_doc: Active skills. The skill circle has the diameter of the enemy lane (tower.json battlefield.enemyLaneY); "areaScale" is the zone diameter as a share of it. Damage is a share of the max HP of each enemy, "bossDamageMul" on bosses. vfx: sheet of cellW x cellH frames (8 per row), "hitFrame" = frame when the effect lands; placement: wall | path | area | towers | towerFront | contact; anchorX / anchorY: point of the sheet placed on the target (default 0.5); size: px width of one sprite (area: share of the zone diameter); extra: more sprites at [dx, dy] x zone diameter from the center. Passives ("passives"): work while a hero has learned them. "buffs": {key, value} like hero buffs; "params": numbers of the passive's own rule (see CombatManager / PassiveRules); "requiresEffect": the book is only sold once that tower effect is unlocked; "cooldownWaves": a passive that triggers, then recharges for that many waves.

skills.name: Air Burst
skills.description: A blast of wind along the wall throws every enemy back, away from the wall.

skills.name: Crater Impact
skills.description: Every enemy is stunned for 5 s (even when immune; the time is never reduced) and loses 20% of its max HP.

skills.name: Fire Cast
skills.description: Calls a small fire zone (half of the skill circle) at the chosen spot: enemies inside lose 80% of their max HP.

skills.name: Ice Cast
skills.description: Calls a small ice zone (half of the skill circle) at the chosen spot: enemies inside lose 80% of their max HP.

skills.name: Lightning Cast
skills.description: Calls a small lightning zone (half of the skill circle) at the chosen spot: enemies inside lose 80% of their max HP.

skills.name: Shadow Cast
skills.description: Calls a small shadow zone (half of the skill circle) at the chosen spot: enemies inside lose 80% of their max HP.

skills.name: Nature Cast
skills.description: Calls a small nature zone (half of the skill circle) at the chosen spot: enemies inside lose 80% of their max HP.

skills.name: Arcane Cast
skills.description: Calls a small arcane zone (half of the skill circle) at the chosen spot: enemies inside lose 80% of their max HP.

skills.name: Holy Sword Hit
skills.description: Holy swords strike the whole battlefield: every enemy loses 40% of its max HP.

skills.name: Divine Beam
skills.description: A beam of light falls on the chosen spot. Enemies in a small zone (3/8 of the skill circle) lose 100% of their max HP.

skills.name: Frost Circle
skills.description: A frost magic circle opens on the chosen spot. Enemies in a small zone (3/8 of the skill circle) lose 100% of their max HP.

skills.name: Solar Circle
skills.description: A solar magic circle opens on the chosen spot. Enemies in a small zone (3/8 of the skill circle) lose 100% of their max HP.

skills.name: Spirit Circle
skills.description: A spirit magic circle opens on the chosen spot. Enemies in a small zone (3/8 of the skill circle) lose 100% of their max HP.

skills.name: Crimson Circle
skills.description: A crimson magic circle opens on the chosen spot. Enemies in a small zone (3/8 of the skill circle) lose 100% of their max HP.

skills.name: Meteor Strike
skills.description: A meteor crashes on the chosen spot. Enemies in a small zone (9/16 of the skill circle) lose 100% of their max HP.

skills.name: Angel Feather
skills.description: Doubles the damage of every tower (+100% of the current damage) for 15 s.

skills.name: Gravity Well
skills.description: A gravity well on the chosen spot pulls the enemies of the skill circle to its center, then they lose 20% of their max HP.

skills.name: Fire Tornado
skills.description: Fire tornadoes sweep the whole battlefield: every enemy loses 20% of its max HP.

skills.name: Buff Arrow
skills.description: Doubles the attack speed of every tower (+100% of the current speed) for 15 s.

skills.name: Holy Heal
skills.description: Holy light runs along the wall and restores it to full HP.

skills.name: Barrier Block
skills.description: Blocks the next 20 hits on the wall. Only lasts for the wave it is cast in.

skills.name: Lightning Strike
skills.description: Lightning bolts rain on the chosen spot. Enemies inside the skill circle lose 50% of their max HP.

skills.name: Rock Fall
skills.description: Rocks fall on the chosen spot. Enemies inside the skill circle lose 50% of their max HP.

skills.name: Void Rift
skills.description: Void rifts tear open on the chosen spot. Enemies inside the skill circle lose 50% of their max HP.

heroSkills._doc: Hero skills: an active skill (the skills above) can be used once every cooldownWaves waves (research lowers it). 5-star heroes learn 1 active + 1 passive skill, the others 1 skill of any type. Learning uses one skill book and learnCost.

bookShop._doc: Skill books sold in the Market (Skill Books tab): a new random choice of offersMin..offersMax books every wave. Gold price = priceBase * (1 + wave * pricePerWave) * bookPriceMul of the skill, +/- fluctuation %.

passives.name: Skewer
passives.description: Passive: enemies hit by Piercing Bolt can also get the Crossbow's Bleed and Hunter's Mark, like the first target.

passives.name: Long Shot
passives.description: Passive: Piercing Bolt hits 2 more enemies and jumps farther (200 instead of 140).

passives.name: Hemorrhage
passives.description: Passive: when Bleed reaches its full stacks, enemies nearby get 2 Bleed stacks. With Bleeding Bolt Mastery 3, Bleed also deals 0.1% of the current HP per second per stack (before that: +50% Bleed damage).

passives.name: Deep Cuts
passives.description: Passive: with Bleeding Bolt Mastery 3, Bleed bursts 1 stack earlier and the burst deals 6% max HP (before that: +50% Bleed damage).

passives.name: Prey
passives.description: Passive: when an enemy with full Hunter's Mark stacks dies, 3 stacks move to the closest enemy.

passives.name: Open Season
passives.description: Passive: Hunter's Mark also makes the enemy take more damage from every other tower, at 1/3 of its value.

passives.name: Deep Freeze
passives.description: Passive: a slowed enemy hit by Frost Explosion 2 more times is frozen (stunned) for 1 s.

passives.name: Bitter Cold
passives.description: Passive: Frost Explosion slows 15% more, and slowed enemies take +15% damage from Crystal towers.

passives.name: Conductor
passives.description: Passive: Chain Lightning jumps to slowed enemies first and stuns them for 0.3 s.

passives.name: Overload
passives.description: Passive: every Chain Lightning jump deals +10% more than the one before.

passives.name: Arcane Rupture
passives.description: Passive: at full Arcane Vulnerability stacks the enemy explodes: the stacks are removed and it and the enemies nearby take magic damage (4% max HP with Arcane Vulnerability Mastery 3, flat damage before).

passives.name: Spell Weave
passives.description: Passive: Arcane Vulnerability stacks also raise the damage of hero skills by half of their value.

passives.name: Aftershock
passives.description: Passive: an enemy stunned by Shockwave takes +30% damage until 1 s after the stun.

passives.name: Tremor
passives.description: Passive: Shockwave stuns 0.2 s longer and its stun-immune hit deals 6% max HP instead of 4% (before Mastery 2: +50% Shockwave damage).

passives.name: Crusher
passives.description: Passive: Heavy Impact deals 10/6 as much to enemies with Armor Break or stunned (6% max HP becomes 10%).

passives.name: Giant Slayer
passives.description: Passive: Heavy Impact deals +50% to bosses (1/2 of the normal share instead of 1/3).

passives.name: Sunder
passives.description: Passive: Armor Break stacks up to 3 times instead of only refreshing.

passives.name: Exposed
passives.description: Passive: enemies with Armor Break take +25% critical damage.

passives.name: Last Stand
passives.description: Passive: when the wall would fall below 1 HP, it stays at 1 HP for 20 s. Recharges in 15 waves.

passives.name: Bulwark
passives.description: Passive: when the wall falls below 50% HP, its defense is tripled for 30 s. Recharges in 10 waves.

passives.name: Spoils of War
passives.description: Passive: after a boss is defeated, the next building production is 10 times bigger.

passives.name: Time Warp
passives.description: Passive: after every wave, a random hero skill that is recharging needs 1 wave less.

passives.name: Treasure Hunter
passives.description: Passive: +1 gold for every normal enemy killed; +1 Energy Core and +8888 gold for every boss.

passives.name: Hawk's Gaze
passives.description: Passive: every tower gets +35% critical chance.
